facts: Grantor conveyed her residence into the Helen Marsh Revocable Living Trust. Helen is the settlor and the sole present beneficiary of the trust. She continues to live in the home. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: 27a(7)(g)(i) — settlor is sole present beneficiary. Baseline trust case. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
